question: Calculate the average rating for each product by category, excluding categories with an average rating lower than 3.

pred_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, p.product_id, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY c.name, p.product_id HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 3;
raw_output: SELECT c.name AS category_name, p.product_id, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY c.name, p.product_id HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 3;
